assessments.reasoning: Ecma International publishes the controlling ECMA-262 15th-edition algorithm. Fresh direct acquisition returned the exact registered source SHA-256. The descriptor algorithm returns the specified writable descriptor after reading the export. The namespace [[Set]] algorithm returns false in its only step. In ECMAScript 2024, a module namespace exotic object's own descriptor for a normally retrieved string export has [[Writable]] true, while its [[Set]] internal method returns false. The object is a module namespace exotic object. The descriptor request concerns a string key in its [[Exports]] and the export read completes normally. Symbol keys take a separate descriptor branch. The statement concerns the internal methods and does not assert the outcome of every JavaScript assignment expression or change to the exporting module's own binding. An absent string export produces undefined before the descriptor is created. The writable descriptor does not route the namespace object's Set through an ordinary object's Set algorithm.
